svg.text: T16@150 TOP E.W. OVER THE COLUMN - LENGTH PER THE OFFICE RULE (SEE NOTES)
COLUMN · BAR ENDING AT THE SLAB EDGE / AN OPENING ENDS IN A U: DOWN THE SLAB, 500 BACK AT THE BOTTOM
1. ALL DIMENSIONS ARE IN MILLIMETRES, LEVELS IN METRES UNLESS NOTED OTHERWISE. DO NOT SCALE; FOLLOW THE WRITTEN DIMENSIONS.
2. CONCRETE f'c = 35 MPa (drawing). REINFORCEMENT: DEFORMED BARS fy = 420 MPa (drawing). CLEAR COVER 25 mm TOP AND BOTTOM
3. SLAB THICKNESS 250 mm. THIS SHEET IS TO BE READ WITH THE CONSULTANT'S STRUCTURAL DRAWINGS (G.A.) AND THE PT LAYOUT;
DISCREPANCIES TO BE REFERRED TO THE ENGINEER BEFORE FABRICATION.
4. BAR CALL-OUT: [No.] T[Ø] @[SPACING] - [LAYER-MARK] - (L = CUTTING LENGTH). STRAIGHT LENGTH IS WRITTEN UNDER THE BAR; A HOOK LEG
IS WRITTEN AT THE HOOKED END. T1/T2 = TOP LAYERS, B1/B2 = BOTTOM LAYERS (1 = BARS PARALLEL TO THE NUMBERED GRIDS, 2 = PARALLEL TO
5. THE DRAWN BAR IS REPRESENTATIVE OF THE GROUP; THE NUMBER OF BARS IN THE CALL-OUT IS PLACED AT THE GIVEN SPACING ACROSS THE
ZONE. A SHORT OFFSET LINE MARKS THE LAP OF THE FOLLOWING PIECE.
6. TENSION LAPS ARE CLASS B (1.3 ld) PER SBC 304-18 §25.5.2, SO ALL BARS OF A ROW MAY LAP AT THE SAME SECTION. BARS ENDING AT A
FREE EDGE TERMINATE WITH A STANDARD 90° HOOK (12 Ø) UNLESS NOTED.
7. ADDITIONAL TOP BARS T16@150 OVER EVERY COLUMN: T1 PARALLEL TO THE NUMBERED GRIDS (PLAN 1), T2 PARALLEL TO THE LETTERED GRIDS
(PLAN 2), PLACED WITHIN c2 + 1.5h EACH SIDE OF THE COLUMN. OFFICE RULE: AN INTERIOR COLUMN BAR COVERS THE DROP PANEL WHERE THERE
IS ONE, OTHERWISE 4000 mm IN TOTAL; AN EDGE COLUMN BAR ENDS IN A U AT THE SLAB EDGE (DOWN THE SLAB, 500 mm BACK AT THE BOTTOM) AND
RUNS 70 % OF THE INTERIOR LENGTH (2800 mm) ON TOP FROM THE EDGE.
8. EVERY TOP BAR THAT ENDS AT THE OUTER SLAB EDGE OR AT AN OPENING ENDS IN A U: VERTICAL LEG THROUGH THE SLAB DEPTH AND A 500 mm
BOTTOM LEG ("U500" AT THE BAR END; SHAPE U / UU IN THE SCHEDULE, THE CUTTING LENGTH INCLUDES BOTH LEGS).
9. MINIMUM BONDED REINFORCEMENT OVER COLUMNS As = 0.00075·Acf (§8.6.2.3) IS CHECKED PER COLUMN; WHERE IT GOVERNS THE BAR COUNT IS
INCREASED (TYPE TABLE, DETAIL 2). TOP BARS SIT BELOW THE TOP COVER, ABOVE THE TENDONS, ON CHAIRS.
A1. Bottom mesh not specified: T12@200 both ways assumed as bonded reinforcement in PT zones.
A2. Edge U-bars not specified: T12@150 with 1200 mm legs assumed at PT anchorage edges.
A3. Opening trimmers not specified: 2T16 T&B each side + 2T12 diagonals at corners assumed.
A4. Void trimmers not specified: 2T12 T&B each side assumed.
A5. Stock bar length 12 m; laps staggered so that not more than 50 % of bars lap at one section.
SBC 304-18 AS STATED ON THE STRUCTURAL DRAWINGS. DEVELOPMENT, ANCHORAGE AND LAP LENGTHS PER SBC 304-18 CHAPTER 25 (ACI 318-14
